units.source_text: 老人家跟杜子春告别之后，又跨上竹杖，飞上群山上空，瞬间消失的无影无踪。

en.t: After saying farewell to Du Zichun, the old man climbed back onto his bamboo staff, flew up over the mountains, and vanished without a trace in an instant.

units.source_text: 此刻虽然夜色缥缈，但是也能依稀看见陡峭的山峰。

en.t: Although the night was hazy at that moment, the steep mountain peaks could still be seen faintly.
